title: Product landing page
what: A full landing page for one product: header, hero with picture slot, proof strip of 3 numbers, 3 features, 3 screenshots, offer box with price, 4 FAQ items, closing call and footer; one column on a phone.

slots.TITLE: Send proposals clients sign the same day
slots.SUBTITLE: Slatewise is a set of 18 ready proposal layouts with pricing tables that add up on their own. Fill in the scope, export a PDF and send it while the call is still fresh.
slots.CTA_NOTE: One-time price. Instant download. No account.
slots.FEATURES_TITLE: Built for the hour before you hit send
slots.FEATURE_1_TEXT: Pick a layout for a fixed fee, a retainer or a phased project. Every page is already typeset, so you only replace the words.
slots.FEATURE_2_TITLE: Prices that add up on their own
slots.FEATURE_2_TEXT: Line items, discounts and tax roll into one total. Change a number and the summary on page one follows.
slots.FEATURE_3_TITLE: A PDF that looks like you
slots.FEATURE_3_TEXT: Set your logo, two colours and a typeface once. Every proposal you export after that carries them.
slots.SHOTS_TITLE: See the pages your client opens
slots.SHOT_1_CAPTION: Cover page with the scope summary and one clear total.
slots.OFFER_TEXT: Pay once and keep every file. Use the kit for as many clients as you like.
slots.OFFER_ITEM_3: Editable source files and a PDF export preset
slots.FAQ_1_Q: What do I need to open the files?
slots.FAQ_1_A: Any editor that opens DOCX or ODT files. The PDF preset works with the export function built into those editors.
slots.FAQ_2_Q: Can I use it for client work?
slots.FAQ_2_A: Yes. One licence covers every proposal you send under your own name or your studio.
slots.FAQ_3_A: Every 1.x update is free. You get an email with a fresh download link when one is ready.
slots.FAQ_4_Q: What if it does not fit my work?
slots.FAQ_4_A: Write to us within 14 days of buying and you get a full refund.
slots.CLOSE_TITLE: Your next proposal can go out today
slots.CLOSE_TEXT: Download the kit, pick a layout and send it before lunch.
slots.FOOT_NOTE: © 2026 Slatewise. Made by a studio of two.
